def get_canon(comp):
    offs=[(r-min(r for r,_ in comp),c-min(c for _,c in comp)) for r,c in comp]
    h=max(r for r,_ in offs)+1; w=max(c for _,c in offs)+1
    out=set()
    funcs={
      'id':lambda o:o,
      'r90cw':lambda o:(o[1],-o[0]),
      'r180':lambda o:(-o[0],-o[1]),
      'r90ccw':lambda o:(-o[0],o[1]),
      'T':lambda o:(o[1],o[0]),
      'V':lambda o:(o[0],-o[1]),
      'H':lambda o:(-o[0],o[1])}
    for name,tor in funcs.items():
        m=[[0]*max(w,h) for _ in range(max(w,h))]
        for rr,cc in [tor((r,c)) for r,c in offs]:
            m[rr][cc]=1
        out.add(tuple(tuple(row) for row in m))
    return sorted(out,key=str)[0]

import os,re,numpy as np,json,itertools
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()
def components(I):
    H,W=len(I),len(I[0]); seen=set(); comps=[]
    for i in range(H):
        for j in range(W):
            if I[i][j]==2 and (i,j) not in seen:
                stack=[(i,j)]; comp=set()
                while stack:
                    r,c=stack.pop()
                    if (r,c) in comp: continue
                    comp.add((r,c)); seen.add((r,c))
                    for dr,dc in itertools.product((-1,0,1),(-1,0,1)):
                        nr,nc=r+dr,c+dc
                        if 0<=nr<H and 0<=nc<W and I[nr][nc]==2 and (nr,nc) not in comp:
                            stack.append((nr,nc))
                comps.append(comp)
    return comps
def norm(s): 
    r0=min(r for r,_ in s); c0=min(c for _,c in s)
    return tuple(sorted((r-r0,c-c0) for r,c in s)),r0,c0
fam_map={frozenset({(0,0),(0,1),(0,2),(1,1)}):'D', frozenset({(0,1),(1,0),(1,1),(1,2)}):'U'}
tab=[]
for n in range(1,8):
    I=G[f'Demo pair {n} input']; O=G[f'Demo pair {n} output']
    H,W=len(I),len(I[0])
    comps=[sorted(c) for c in components(I)]
    fams=[fam_map.get(frozenset(norm(s)[0])) for s in comps]
    marks=[(r,c,O[r][c]) for r in range(len(O)) for c in range(len(O[0])) if O[r][c]!=0]
    ok=True; P=[]
    for i,s in enumerate(comps):
        rs,cc=norm(s)[1],norm(s)[2]; f=fams[i]
        col=3 if f=='D' else 1
        cand=[(mr,mc) for mr,mc,v in marks if v==col]
        if len(cand)!=1 or len(marks)!=len(comps): ok=False
        (mr,mc)=cand[0]
        P.append(((rs,cc),(mr,mc)))
    if not ok: print('demo',n,'mismatch counts'); continue
    X=np.array([[a,b] for a,b,_,_ in P]); Y=np.array([[c,d] for _,c,d in P])
    R,c_=np.linalg.lstsq(X,Y,rcond=None)[0]
    err=np.max(np.abs(Y-np.dot(X,R)-c_))
    tab.append((n,R,c_,err,P))
    print(n,'R=',R,'c=',c_,'maxerr',err)

        s=n+1

def f(g):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    bg=Counter(v for r in g for v in r).most_common(1)[0][0]
    cs=comps(g,bg); main=max(cs,key=len)
    pts=list(main)
    py0=min(y for y,x in pts); px0=min(x for y,x in pts)
    pat={(y-py0,x-px0):g[y][x] for y,x in pts}
    ph=max(p for p,_ in pat)+1; pw=max(q for _,q in pat)+1
    sy=(ph-1)//2; sx=(pw-1)//2
    res=[row[:] for row in g]
    noise=[c[0] for c in sorted(cs,key=len,reverse=True)[1:]]
    for nr,nc in noise:
        best=None
        for (dr,dc),qv in pat.items():
            if qv==bg: continue
            tr,tc=nr-dr,nc-dc
            okk=True
            for (p_,q_),pv in pat.items():
                yy=tr+p_; xx=tc+q_
                if not(0<=yy<H and 0<=xx<W): okk=False;break
                if g[yy][xx]!=bg and pv!=g[yy][xx]: okk=False;break
            if okk:
                best=(tr,tc);break
        if best is None:
            tr,tc=nr-sy,nc-sx
        for (p_,qv_) in pat.items():
            y,x=best[0]+p_,best[1]+q_
            if 0<=y<H and 0<=x<W:
                res[y][x]=qv_
    return res
allok=all(f(G[f'Demo pair {i} input'])==G[f'Demo pair {i} output'] for i in range(1,9))
print('ALL',allok)

def f(g):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    bg=Counter(v for r in g for v in r).most_common(1)[0][0]
    cs=comps(g,bg); main=max(cs,key=len)
    pts=list(main)
    py0=min(y for y,x in pts); px0=min(x for y,x in pts)
    pat={(y-py0,x-px0):g[y][x] for y,x in pts}
    ph=max(p for p,_ in pat)+1; pw=max(q for _,q in pat)+1
    sy,sx=(ph-1)//2,(pw-1)//2
    res=[row[:] for row in g]
    noise=[c[0] for c in sorted(cs,key=len,reverse=True)[1:]]
    for nr,nc in noise:
        tr,tc=nr-sy,nc-sx
        for (p_,q_),qv_ in pat.items():
            yy,xx=tr+p_,tc+q_
